ATOMIC — PRESS KIT
Updated 2 November 2026
Product: https://atomicapp.dev/
Press room: https://atomicapp.dev/press/

Open index.html to browse the documents and media. Read 01-documents/00-complete-press-book.pdf for the complete illustrated book. Individual documents are supplied as PDF, DOCX, HTML and TXT, with current screenshots and cover artwork embedded where relevant.

01-documents — Product, company, announcement, facts, people, FAQ, brand guidance, video guide and evergreen social copy.
02-logos — Original SVG, transparent PNG and PDF exports; uppercase/lowercase light and dark variants, standalone symbol and original supplied files.
03-screenshots — 17 framed product views plus 17 unframed PNGs; SVG masters for views containing updated logos. Original screen content is preserved outside the logo area. Captions and context included.
04-portraits — Founder and team portraits.
05-video — Three date-free 35-second films: widescreen, square and vertical. Approved narration and music; built-in captions in the social formats. SRT, VTT and transcript included.
06-social — Matching opening-design covers for all three films and evergreen social copy.

Lead product image: 03-screenshots/01-home.png.
Story: idea or template; builder; Canvas styling and collaboration; reviewed publication and app management; logs and usage; source access and download.
Book cover: Atomic home screen. The product story moves from ideas and templates through the builder, Canvas, publishing, logs and source access.
Recommended cover: the matching atomic-launch-*-cover.png for each format.
All product imagery shows local sample applications and data. Builder conversations are staged; the screenshot comment composer is a draft. Billing values are illustrative.

BRAND REFRESH
The logo files, document branding, presentation frames and social covers use the 2 November 2026 identity. App screenshot branding uses the current lowercase identity. The three existing films retain the identity visible when recorded.
